Definition: from G2425; to enable, i.e. qualify:--make able (meet).
BiblicalUsage: hikanóō means to make able, to make fit. It turns up twice, in 2 Corinthians and Colossians.
TheologicalSignificance: I read hikanóō plainly: to make able, to make fit, and I leave it there.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
